head: Blue Phone: a Pixel 10 Pro with an AI assistant that works across your apps
dek: Startup Blue opened the public beta of Blue Phone, a Pixel 10 Pro or Pro XL running its own Blue OS, where an AI assistant does tasks across apps for you.
details: It can handle several tasks at once and turn voice recordings into written messages. It costs $1,299; iPhone users can get it free by trading in their old phone within 30 days. Blue is backed by Y Combinator.
means: It's an early look at phones built around an AI that acts for you, not just answers.
todo: It's a beta: read what data the assistant can see before switching your main phone.
